sc_cat_item.description: Use this form as the single intake point for all vendor-related requests for Propelis. This request initiates either a New Vendor request or a Vendor Update request. All submissions are routed to the Vendor Master Data team for vetting to prevent uncontrolled supplier onboarding and ensure vendor master updates are consistently validated and auditable.
sc_cat_item.name: Vendor Master Data Request
sc_cat_item.short_description: Submit a standardized request to initiate a New Vendor onboarding or a Vendor Update."
